summary: Make maintenance release acceptance self-contained and Cloudflare-compatible.
details: Commit 7d7171924f5869b6012e362cf66e57d43d38dcd9 makes the maintenance runner mint its 60-second read-only candidate probe token in memory, gives authenticated acceptance POSTs the same declared release User-Agent as GET checks, and rejects incorrectly prefixed Python runtime digest evidence during preparation.
operator_impact: Maintenance releases no longer require an operator-created acceptance-token file, and deterministic Cloudflare browser-signature rejection is caught by tests before deployment.
